rows.note: Use this for an absolute understood specifically as a universally valid or unquestionable truth, such as a moral absolute.

example.english: Philosophers have debated for thousands of years whether there is an absolute truth in the world.
example.traditional: 世界上有冇絕對真理，哲學家爭論咗幾千年。
example.jyutping: sai3 gaai3 soeng6 jau5 mou5 zyut6 deoi3 zan1 lei5 zit3 hok6 gaa1 zaang1 leon6 zo2 gei2 cin1 nin4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for emphatic meanings such as total, perfect, unquestionable, or unrestricted.

example.english: I have absolute confidence that what he said is true.
example.traditional: 我絕對相信佢講嘅係真話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zyut6 deoi3 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 zan1 waa6

rows.note: Choose this when absolute means that no conditions or qualifications apply.

example.english: The company made an absolute commitment to refund me, with no conditions attached.
example.traditional: 公司答應無條件退錢畀我。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 daap3 jing3 mou4 tiu4 gin6 teoi3 cin2 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this specifically for a ruler or authority that is domineering and exercises unchecked control.

example.english: That emperor was an absolute tyrant and made every decision himself.
example.traditional: 嗰個皇帝好專制，乜都自己話事。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 wong4 dai3 hou2 zyun1 zai3 mat1 dou1 zi6 gei2 waa6 si6

rows.note: Use this for a substance that is pure and unmixed, especially in everyday descriptions.

example.english: This is pure milk with a rich flavour—an absolute delight.
example.traditional: 呢杯係純牛奶，飲落好香濃。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 hai6 seon4 ngau4 naai5 jam2 lok6 hou2 hoeng1 nung4
